column3: Held up towards back of field - urged forward 3f out - made progress 2f out - edged in front over 1f out - driven out and battled through final furlong - held on by a whisker
Settled at the back early - made steady progress over 2f out and closed on the front pair - battled gamely through the last furlong - edged out narrowly at the line
Went straight to the front - driven on and drifted right approaching 3f out - overtaken inside the final furlong - unable to respond and finished third
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - boxed in with 1f to run and lost ground - finished 4th
Tracked the front group early - urged into effort with 3f left and stayed the course for a time - lost momentum before the final furlong to finish fifth

Settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along in pursuit of the front-runner over 2f out - closed in approaching the final furlong - found more to hit the front inside the last 110yds and drew clear for the win
Sent to the front early - holding a two length advantage 2f out - pressed for effort and up by a length approaching the last furlong - unable to find more and overtaken close to home
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - well placed with the pace - pressed for effort 3f out and edged back into third 2f out - unable to close from there and held for the show
Sluggish start - fought for control early - settled towards the back - pressed for effort and lost touch with the pace 3f out - improved into fourth inside the final furlong but well beaten
Pulled hard early - travelling with the front group - pressed 3f out and gave way - beaten into last inside final furlong
Set the pace from the off - pressed for effort inside final furlong - held on strongly to prevail

Settled at the back early - made steady progress into contention over 2f out - chased the front-runner and driven out inside the final furlong - kept up the chase to the line but never able to get on terms
Held a midfield position early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - stayed on to grab third late
Tracked leader in second - pressed for effort over 2f out - unable to close and dropped away with over a furlong left - finished fourth
Sat just behind the leading duo - pressed for effort 2f out and dropped away - finished well held in 5th
Slow to begin - settled at back of field - driven with 3f left but never a factor - finished 6th
Set the pace from the start - pushed along with 2f left - held on comfortably to the line
Knocked at the off - settled towards back not far off pace - pushed along with 2f left - closed late but couldn't quite reach winner
Pulled hard early - close order with front group - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on inside final furlong - unable to close final 110yds
Hampered start and hesitant into stride - settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on at one tempo late to finish fourth
Drifted left at the off - fought for control early - up with the pace - pushed along 2f out and faded inside final furlong
Slow to break - held towards back - improved position out wide 2f out - pushed along with a furlong left - hit front close home and stayed on strongly to win

Settled midpack early - shifted right and asked for effort over a furlong out then edged left as drive continued - in contention with 110yds left - unable to match winner's finishing speed and beaten 1.25 lengths in 2nd
Just in front early - driven approaching 2f out and stayed on well - overtaken inside the final furlong - unable to reclaim advantage at the finish
Tracked the pace - made headway approaching 2f out and looked poised entering the final furlong - held to fourth in the final 110yds
Sat close to front group early - asked for effort 2f out - stayed on before weakening inside final 110yds - finished 5th
Restrained at the back - nudged into contention from 2f out - kept on without threatening
Sat close to front - urged forward inside final two furlongs - lost ground steadily to finish seventh
Held up in midfield - driven with three furlongs left - lost touch inside final furlong - eventually finished eighth
Settled in the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost touch inside the final furlong - finished ninth well held
Settled behind the front group - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - held on well to score
Fought for control early - shared front spot - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs - overtaken entering last furlong and battled on to be edged out narrowly
Held up in the pack - moved right and pushed along 2f out - closed on the front group entering final furlong - stayed on well to finish third
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f left before angling right and finishing well inside the final furlong - narrowly denied third
Held up at the rear from the off - late headway brings fifth place at the finish
Shared the front spot early - pushed along with two furlongs left then lost command inside the final furlong - dropped away quickly after finishing 6th
Settled off the pace in the pack - made steady progress into contention 2f out - shared third place under pressure with a furlong left - driven out in the closing stages to get up and win on the line
Tracked pace early - roused to hit front approaching 2f out - driven out inside final furlong and stayed on - pressed hard close home - caught in the last strides to lose out by a whisker
Set the pace early - driven and lost the front inside final two furlongs - stayed on gamely with a shout in the last furlong but couldn't find more and just missed out
Hampered hard at the break - settled towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - found room and stayed on inside the last - grabbed fourth late without reaching the front
Held up towards the back - driven to improve inside final furlong - kept on late without threatening the leaders
Handy early - driven approaching final furlong - held no more inside final 110 yards - finished sixth beaten 2 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort 2f out - kept going late but hampered for space inside final 110 yards - finished seventh beaten two lengths
Settled just off the pace early - nudged for effort with over 2f left and slipped back through the field - driven but unable to respond a furlong out - finished eighth beaten 3.25 lengths
Bumped at the break - settled near the back - driven approaching 2f out but unable to find any headway - finished 9th
Drifted right at the off - settled in the pack - drifted left approaching 2f out then eased back through the field in the closing stages
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final two furlongs - lost ground close home - finished 11th
Slow to break and settled at back - urged forward 3f out - made rapid progress 2f out to hit the front entering last furlong - powered clear to the finish
Held mid-pack early - boxed in over 2f out then pushed along - moved into second inside final furlong - held on for the runner-up spot behind the winner
Fought for control early - tracked front pair - pushed into advantage over 2f out - dropped back before finishing third
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort and lost touch over 2f out - stayed on inside the last - finished fourth without threatening

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - travelled up with the pace and hit the front approaching 2f out - shaken up but handed back the advantage inside the final furlong - faded quickly thereafter - finished fifth well beaten
Fought for control early - went clear in front before being overtaken with just over two furlongs left - lost touch soon after finishing sixth
Held up towards the back - driven forward with vigour over 2f out then work needed as pace quickened approaching the last furlong - hit the front close home to win
Drifted right at start - settled midfield - made progress 3f out - driven up to challenge 2f out - hit front inside final furlong - just caught close home
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - kept fighting in the finish - edged out for third by three quarters of a length
Held up towards the back - improved into contention 2f out under pressure - up to third a furlong out - kept on but lacked the speed to get closer
Slow to break - settled midfield - asked for effort over 2f out - kept on without threatening
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort with 2f left - dropped away final furlong - finished 6th
Held up towards the back - made ground into contention over 2f out under pressure - stayed on same gear to finish seventh
Handy early - urged into effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 8th
Held up close to the pace early - dropped away with over 2f left - pressed for effort inside the final furlong then eased back through the field late
Held up in the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - found nothing - eventually beaten well into 10th
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - unable to find any improvement - finished well beaten in 11th
Sat handy early - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away with more than a furlong to run - finished 12th
Knocked at the off - settled towards the back - made a little progress over 2f out - driven approaching the furlong pole and faded out of contention
Held up eagerly in third - pushed along over a furlong out and moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Went straight to front - pushed along with 2f to run - held on well approaching final furlong before being overtaken - unable to find more late and beaten a neck
Sat in second early - nudged for effort with a furlong left - lost ground close home - finished third
Held up at rear - lost touch and driven approaching 2f out - showed little thereafter - finished fourth
Settled in fourth - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground in final furlong - finished fifth
Sat behind pace early - moved through to hit front two out and pushed clear - kept responding to the line
Settled off the pace early - improved into contention 2f out and pressed on under pressure from a furlong out - narrowly denied in the final strides
Held up towards the back early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear inside final furlong - finished third
Set the pace unchallenged - pushed along and lost the front spot inside the final 2f - dropped away fast in the last furlong to finish 4th

Wide early and within range of the front pack - linked up with rivals past the 4f mark - moved into second by 3f out - went in front over 2f out - fended off the challenger inside the last - saw out the finish for a clear-cut win

Sluggish start settling at the back - made progress into contention approaching 2f out - pushed along to move into second inside the final furlong - stayed on to close on the leader late - unable to reel in winner and beaten by half a length
Settled in the pack early - made progress three furlongs out and pressed for effort with two to run - moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third beaten 3 lengths
Held up in midfield - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on into fourth close home
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - settled in the pack - driven into contention 3f out - weakened approaching the final furlong to finish well held
Wide early - well placed with leaders - went to front after 8f - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - faded final furlong to finish 6th
Set the pace early - lost the advantage past 8f but stayed close up - driven on with 3f left before fading out of contention late
Held up close to the pace early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack early - unable to improve position through the race - well beaten in 9th at the finish
Wide of the field early - travelled handily then merged with the pack after 5f - asked for effort 4f out - knocked off stride and unbalanced 3f out - faded soon after - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - dropped away approaching 3f out - faded from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - well held at the finish
Held up near back - urged forward with 8f left before losing touch 6f out - well adrift from 5f out to finish last
Went straight to the front - driven over 2f out and forged ahead in the final furlong - value for more than the winning margin at the line
Settled in third early - pushed along approaching 2f out and moved into second inside final furlong - stayed on to the line without threatening the leader - finished second beaten 3 lengths
Held second early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped a place and faded inside the final furlong - finished third
Sat close to front rank - pushed along with over 2f left before hitting front inside final furlong - powered clear to the line
Settled midpack - pushed along with 2f left - finished strongly late but denied by a head
Settled at the back - angled right and pushed along 2f out - showed inexperience - closed strongly inside final furlong to take 3rd
Just in front early - pushed along 2f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong - drifted about and faded to finish fourth
Tracked the front pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left and still holding a shout with a furlong to run - couldn't find more late and finished fifth beaten 3.25 lengths
Tardy away - settled towards the back - nudged along and picked up 2f out - stayed on into 6th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and knocked off stride inside final furlong - finished with a late flourish to be 8th
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished ninth
Settled midfield in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 10th
Held up towards back of field - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to close - eventually finished 11th
Tracked the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away fast and was allowed to drop out inside the final furlong - finished well held in 12th
Refused to line up - took no part
Handy early - hit front two and a half out and drifted left approaching 2f - driven along and matched stride for stride - dug in gamely to the line for the win
Sat close up early - moved into 3rd and going smoothly with 2f left before pushed into 2nd inside final furlong - held that spot to the line finishing 2nd beaten 3 lengths
Held up at the back early - into the middle group by halfway - onto 5th and driven 3f out - up to 3rd inside final 2f - stuck on same speed through the closing stages to finish third
Sets pace from the off - loses front spot after 3f - given a squeeze into the straight - slips to 3rd around 1 1/2f out - down to 4th with a furlong left - unable to find more late and held for 4th
Held up towards the back - urged forward in 6th with 2f left - 5th approaching final furlong - unable to find more late on and finished 5th
Slow to break - held towards back of pack - urged forward with 3f left - modest 8th approaching final furlong then finished 6th
Hesitant start - soon up with the pace and pulling hard - hit front after 3f - pushed along and lost advantage 2 1/2f out - slipped to 5th final furlong - unable to close late
Settled around midpack - pushed along 3f out but unable to close - held on to finish eighth
Sluggish start - stayed at the rear throughout - well held finishing 9th

Pulled hard and travelled wide early - settled midpack - given a reminder 2f out - boxed in with under a furlong left - forced to angle away and surge through - powered clear inside the final 110 yards to score
Settled in the pack - began to close 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - closed to challenge in the last furlong and edged into second near the line - denied by half a length
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with 2f remaining - moved into second inside the final furlong and hit the front - overtaken close home in the last 110yds - edged out for third at the line
Settled in the pack early - pushed along to close in with 2f left and joined leading group with a furlong to run - held on for fourth without further gain

Held up towards back and pulling hard early - moved up on the wide side approaching halfway - pushed along over 2f out - kept on well through the final furlong - claimed fifth spot inside the last 110yds
Settled at the back - headway from 2f out - kept on but never dangerous
Handy in the pack early - roused to go in front two out then overtaken approaching the final furlong - lost touch late finishing seventh
Pulled hard early in close order - pressed for response over 2f out - made late progress a furlong out - kept going but never a factor at the finish
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm mid-pack early - urged forward two out and briefly found some progress inside the final furlong and a half - faded in the closing stages - finished ninth
Settled towards the back - nudged along 2f out and made only marginal progress 1f out - never threatened
Settled towards the back pulling hard early - pushed along with over 2f left - moved right to find room a furlong out and found a few tired runners - unable to land a serious blow late
Settled at back of the field - pushed along inside final furlong - made no impression - finished well beaten in 12th
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 13th
Went wide in the early stages - up with the pace after 2 furlongs - urged forward with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Sent clear from the start - held advantage until pressed inside final two furlongs - dropped away rapidly once passed - trailed home well beaten in 15th
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away quickly after - well held at the finish

Drifted left and clipped rivals at the off - settled up with the pace through the middle stages - pushed to the front two furlongs out and opened a gap approaching the final furlong - edge narrowed close home but held on for the win

Set out early and settled towards the middle - hit the front but pressed throughout - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - shifted right approaching the final furlong in pursuit of the winner - stayed on at an even rate to finish second

Drifted right and clipped rivals at the break - settled mid-pack down the middle - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on well inside the final furlong - up into third close home - closing best of all at the line
Settled midfield in the group - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on into the final furlong - edged out of third close to the line
Went forward from the stands' rail - hit the front before being overtaken 2f out - stayed on inside the last to finish 5th
Pulled hard early - restrained at the back on the far rail - made ground into the final furlong - ran on without ever threatening the front
Drifted left at the off - settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f to go - continued at a steady gait through the last furlong to finish 7th
Settled in mid-pack down the middle - pushed along with two furlongs left - held the effort through the last furlong - eventually beaten in 8th
Drifted left at the off - settled towards the back through midfield - pushed along with 2f left - nudged closer inside the final furlong to finish 9th
Dwelt at the break - held a mid-division pitch on the rail flank - nudged left and pushed along 2f out - made no inroad in the closing furlong and finished 10th
Quick break drifting wide early - settled midpack - pushed along with 2f left - drifted left under pressure - unable to close final furlong finishing 11th
Held a spot on the far rail early - up with the pace then pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish well held
Settled midpack down the middle of the track - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Held up wide of the pack from the off - never involved and beaten well before the line
Settled off the pace early - shifted wide and began closing from 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong and pulled clear
Settled in a forward spot early - moved into second inside the last furlong - stayed on but unable to reel in the winner - beaten a length and a half in 2nd
Settled in the pack - driven for effort with 2f left - boxed in for room a furlong out - found renewed energy inside final 110yds but unable to get on terms with front group late
Went straight to front early - driven when overtaken with 1f left - dropped away close home to finish 4th
Close to the front group early - urged forward wide out with a furlong left - lost ground close home - finished fifth
Settled just behind the leader early - asked for effort with 3f left - lost ground over a furlong out - dropped away inside the last to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - eased into contention late inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish 7th
Sluggish start - held towards back - improved position late on - lacked the speed to close down the field over the closing stages
Held a forward position early - driven approaching final two furlongs then lost ground - dropped away quickly to finish ninth
Held up in mid-pack early - lost touch a furlong out - dropped away quickly - finished well held in 10th
Held up in the pack - lost touch inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 11th
Handy with the front group early - lost ground approaching 2f out - dropped away steadily to finish 12th
Sat behind front pack - pushed along into 5th with 2f left - moved up to third a furlong out - found extra to hit the front near the line

Settled in the pack early - moved into third with 3f remaining - hit the front looking strong 2f out but soon pressed for effort - overtaken a furlong from home - back in touch for third approaching the line - fought on gamely to snatch second right at the post
Held up towards the back - moved into 5th 3f out - pushed into 2nd inside final 2f - hit the front a furlong out - overtaken and caught in the closing stages - just denied at the line
Held up in midfield - under pressure in 7th with 2f left - moved up to 4th inside final furlong - unable to find more late and finished 4th
Hesitant to find pace early - settled towards the back - improved into 7th with 3f left - pushed along in 6th but unable to close final furlong
Slow to start - held up towards back - improved to 9th with 3f left - pushed along but unable to threaten front-runners
Slow to break - held towards back - improved into 6th with 3f left - unable to threaten front-runners late finishing 7th
Handy early - shared front spot by halfway - went clear 4f out - pushed along and overtaken 2f out then dropped away to finish 8th
Sat handy behind front group - pushed along in 3rd with 2f left - dropped away late finishing 9th
Sluggish start - held up at the back throughout - no impact on the finish
Held up in the front rank early - urged along with 3f remaining - dropped away through the closing stages to finish 11th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 4f left - dropped away late - eventually well beaten in 12th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with three furlongs left - dropped away steadily - finished well beaten in 13th
Set the pace early - matched by a rival at halfway - lost front spot and pressed for effort with 4f left - faded and allowed to drop away last 2f
Tracked the pace - shaken up approaching 2f out to hit the front then drifted left - kept driving through the last furlong to stay on strongly
Settled just behind the pace - urged into contention over a furlong out - edged left inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish second unable to reel in the winner
Slow to break - held a midfield position - shifted left and driven on with a furlong to go - edged left again nearing the final furlong - moved into third close home but found nothing more
Held up towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out and kept responding - improved into fourth late but without threatening
Went to the front early - driven to hold position inside final 2f - overtaken with a furlong left - bumped lightly entering last furlong - weakened close home to finish fifth beaten 3.5 lengths
Held a solitary path down the far rail - up with the pace before being driven approaching 2f out - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Held up at the back - driven with two furlongs left - soon lost touch - finished well beaten in 7th

Settled midway through the field early on - moved across left approaching 2f out - found a good turn of foot to hit the front inside the final furlong - given a squeeze - drifted left but kept finding more to the line
Settled towards the back through the middle stages - made progress a furlong out - eased right and pushed along inside the final furlong - finished strongly - denied by a short margin
Settled midfield down the middle of track - edged right approaching 2f out - pushed along to close the gap inside final furlong - drifted left in the closing stages - stayed on to finish third
Settled among the pack down the middle of the track - improved and moved right approaching the final furlong - pushed along - finished strongly to close the gap - fourth beaten a length and a half
Sluggish start - settled towards the back through the middle of the track - made progress two out - pushed along a furlong out - finished strongly to close on the front runners
Settled towards the back through the middle - pushed along a furlong out - moved left seeking room - stayed on inside the final furlong - finished sixth without threatening

Bumped at the break - settled mid-pack - drifted across to the middle of the track after a furlong - made progress and pushed along with a furlong left - drifted right inside the last - held no more late and finished 7th beaten under four lengths

Settled midpack down the middle of track - shifted right approaching final 2f - made progress inside final furlong - drifted left and flattened out through the closing stages - finished 8th beaten just over four lengths
Settled towards rear on far flank - improved position and pushed along with a furlong left - drifted left approaching the final furlong - held no more late on and finished ninth
Dwelt at the break - moved right to take a position in the middle of the track - settled in the pack - drifted left approaching the final furlong - squeezed for space then rallied to the line in 10th
Settled just off the pace in the middle of the track - pushed along with a furlong left - weakened in the last furlong - finished 11th beaten five lengths
Settled on the far rail among the pack - pressed for effort with a furlong left - eased across to the inner near the finish - stayed on at one speed to finish 12th
Travelled wide of the field early - held a forward spot before being pushed along a furlong out - lost momentum close home to finish 13th

Settled towards the stand rail in a middling position - moved past the only one for company approaching the final furlong - unable to match those coming from the far part of the track and well held in 14th

Sent up early into contention - tracked the pace before drifting across to sit among the middle bunch - pushed along to press forward a furlong out - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish 15th
Held a spot in the middle of the pack early - up with the pace and drifted right approaching 2f out - pressed for advantage a furlong out - weakened close home to finish 16th
Held a middle path early - hit the front and stayed there until pressed inside final furlong - lost position under pressure and dropped away late to finish 17th
Settled towards the back through midfield - angled right approaching the furlong marker - lost momentum inside the final furlong - eventually well beaten in 18th
Settled towards the back on the far flank - stayed off the pace early - made progress inside the final two furlongs - faded close home to finish well behind
Settled midpack on the far rail - drifted left 2f out - unable to find more inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled through the middle of the track - held around midfield - unable to improve position - well held at the finish
Settled midpack after the break - shifted through the middle of the track - improved position but drifted right approaching 2f out - lost momentum in the final furlong to finish well held
Held a position through the middle of the field - pressed on approaching the final furlong - dropped away quickly finishing 23rd
Settled towards the back through the early stages - held that position through the middle of the contest - never landed a blow and finished well beaten in 24th
Drifted right out of the gates - settled towards the stand rail up with the pace - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost the advantage and faded inside the final furlong - well beaten in 25th
Sent forward early on the far flank - stayed handy behind the front group - lost place in a hurry from 2f out
Held a forward position through the middle stages - dropped away rapidly with 2f left - almost eased down entering the final furlong - beaten a long way in 27th

Settled early with a firm grip on the bridle - in close order with the front group - upsides in front from 4f out - hit the front 3f out - driven out 2f out - drifted right but stayed on grimly inside the final furlong - margin shrank late but held on for the win
Pulled hard early - sat close to the front group - eased right and pressed on 2f out - closed on the front-runner entering the final furlong - stayed on but unable to get past close home
Went forward eagerly early on - hit the front - challenged for command 4f out - overtaken 3f out - pushed along and gave up second spot entering the last furlong - outpaced by the front pair late
Settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on late to claim fourth close home
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left and edged closer entering the last furlong - weakened close home to finish fifth
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished sixth
Fought for control early - handy near the front then pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped out of third and faded inside the final furlong
Slow into stride - stayed at the rear throughout - never landed a blow - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled close to the pace - pressed into contention a furlong out and hit the front inside the final 110yds - kept finding to the line
Settled in mid-pack early - eased towards the middle inside the last furlong to gain ground - stayed on strongly over the closing 110yds - claimed runner-up spot close home
Sent clear early and drifted wide - urged forward approaching 2f out - lost front spot and driven inside final furlong - dropped away near the line to finish third beaten a length and a quarter
Dwelt at the start - held up towards the back - made progress from 2f out - squeezed for space approaching the furlong marker - closed on the front group but faded near the line
Settled into second early - dropped back two furlongs out - faded fast inside the last
Stood up at the break - settled in the pack - boxed in and short of room inside the final furlong then faded
Settled in the pack - lost ground approaching the final furlong - dropped away close home to finish 7th
Close to the front pack early - urged forward with 2f left - dropped away fast inside the last
Held up at the back - never able to land a challenge - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back - pushed along and closed in over 2f out - drifted right and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 10th
Held up towards back - squeezed for space over 2f out then pushed into contention 1f out - finished full of running to get up right on the line

Held up towards the back of the pack - squeezed for space with two furlongs left then pushed along - moved strongly into 3rd approaching the last - hit the front early in the straight but caught and unable to find more near the line
Sat behind the pace early - slipped back to 6th with 3f left and pushed along - up to 5th approaching final furlong - stayed on late to finish 3rd
Sat just behind the pace early - shared the front around 3f out - urged along inside the final 2f - lost the advantage entering the last furlong - held for 4th at the line
Held up early - improved on outer approaching 3f out - pressed for 6th spot 2f out - up to 3rd for a moment before unable to find more and finished 5th
Sat handy on the outside - pushed along in 3rd with 2f left - shared the front spot before the last furlong then lost it - unable to fight back late
Settled around midpack early - improved into 4th with 3f left before being pushed along - unable to make further headway inside final furlong finished 7th
Settled in the pack - moved into third with 3f left - pressed for the front 2f out before losing that spot inside the last two furlongs - dropped away to finish eighth
Sets the pace early - given encouragement to keep clear at halfway - reeled in and matched three out - overtaken two out and faded to finish ninth
Settled around midfield - asked for effort 2f out - responded strongly into final furlong - got up close home to win
Held up at back early - made progress from over 2f out into fourth - hit the front a furlong out and stayed on - caught close home to go down by a short margin
Sat handy in mid-pack from the middle - urged forward with over 2f left - kept on to the finish but lacked the speed to land closer - finished third beaten 2 lengths
Held a narrow advantage from the off but continually challenged - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken with a furlong left - battled on at a single gear to finish fourth
Sat behind the front group - shown urging with two furlongs left - faded steadily to finish fifth
Went forward tracking the pace from mid-group - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth
Settled midfield - asked for effort over 2f out - unable to find any headway finishing 7th
Handy racing on the stand's flank - driven with two furlongs to run - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished eighth beaten well over a dozen lengths
Held up in the middle of the field - under pressure 2f out and dropped away - well behind before being allowed to come home in own time
Settled in a central position early - travelled well and disputed the front - driven into command 2f out - edged clear late to prevail by a whisker
